modes.normal: Keys move and act. The status bar shows NORMAL.
modes.insert: Keys go to a text field, the agent's message box (a chat) or its terminal. The status bar shows INSERT.

move.H: See all tasks on the selected agent's machine

act.o / ↵: Type to the agent, in its message box or terminal (insert mode); from Overview, open it
act.c: Clone the task onto a new worktree: same chat, same edits

asks: When the agent on screen asks for permission or a choice, normal mode switches on
asks.↵: Pick, and go back to typing
asks.esc / i: Leave the menu to the agent's terminal

mode.i: Type to the selected agent, in its message box or terminal (insert mode), from any view
mode.esc: Normal mode, from anywhere; closes the open dialog
mode.esc esc: Interrupt the agent (in a terminal, both Esc presses go to it)
